description: Integrations (between two systems): Use when a signed in CRM Connector customer wants one of their integrations paused (nothing syncs, nothing is deleted) or running again (status active, which also switches on a draft once the account has a plan). Ask the person to confirm first. Needs the integration id from list_integrations. Resuming is refused, in words, when a connection needs a new sign in or the plan has no room; share what the answer says. Removing an integration for good is done on its page in CRM Connector.

integration_id.description: The id of the integration, as list_integrations returns it. Ask the person which integration they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

status.description: active to run it, paused to stop it.

name: set_integration_status
title: Pause or resume an integration
